descFull: The General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT) is the world's leading enterprise, multi-mission, open source software system for space mission design, optimization, and navigation. The system supports missions in flight regimes ranging from low Earth orbit to lunar, libration point, and deep space missions. NOTE: Non-release tagged commits are AS IS.
